record.bible_text: Righteous<WH06662> <FI>art<Fi> thou, O LORD<WH03068>, when I plead<WH07378><WTH8799> with thee: yet let me talk<WH01696><WTH8762> with thee of <FI>thy<Fi> judgments<WH04941>: Wherefore doth the way<WH01870> of the wicked<WH07563> prosper<WH06743><WTH8804>? <FI>wherefore<Fi> are all they happy<WH07951><WTH8804> that deal very<WH0899> treacherously<WH0898><WTH8802>? <RF>talk...: or, reason the case with thee<Rf>

Thou hast planted<WH05193><WTH8804> them, yea, they have taken root<WH08327><WTH8776>: they grow<WH03212><WTH8799>, yea, they bring forth<WH06213><WTH8804> fruit<WH06529>: thou <FI>art<Fi> near<WH07138> in their mouth<WH06310>, and far from<WH07350> their reins<WH03629>. <RF>they grow: Heb. they go on<Rf>

But thou, O LORD<WH03068>, knowest<WH03045><WTH8804> me: thou hast seen<WH07200><WTH8799> me, and tried<WH0974><WTH8804> mine heart<WH03820> toward thee: pull them out<WH05423><WTH8685> like sheep<WH06629> for the slaughter<WH02878>, and prepare<WH06942><WTH8685> them for the day<WH03117> of slaughter<WH02028>. <RF>toward...: Heb. with thee<Rf>

How long shall the land<WH0776> mourn<WH056><WTH8799>, and the herbs<WH06212> of every field<WH07704> wither<WH03001><WTH8799>, for the wickedness<WH07451> of them that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> therein? the beasts<WH0929> are consumed<WH05595><WTH8804>, and the birds<WH05775>; because they said<WH0559><WTH8804>, He shall not see<WH07200><WTH8799> our last end<WH0319>.

If thou hast run<WH07323><WTH8804> with the footmen<WH07273>, and they have wearied<WH03811><WTH8686> thee, then how canst thou contend<WH08474><WTH8807> with horses<WH05483>? and <FI>if<Fi> in the land<WH0776> of peace<WH07965>, <FI>wherein<Fi> thou trustedst<WH0982><WTH8802>, <FI>they wearied thee<Fi> , then how wilt thou do<WH06213><WTH8799> in the swelling<WH01347> of Jordan<WH03383>?

For even thy brethren<WH0251>, and the house<WH01004> of thy father<WH01>, even they have dealt treacherously<WH0898><WTH8804> with thee; yea, they have called<WH07121><WTH8804> a multitude<WH04392> after<WH0310> thee: believe<WH0539><WTH8686> them not, though they speak<WH01696><WTH8762> fair words<WH02896> unto thee. <RF>they have called...: or, they cried after thee fully<Rf> <RF>fair...: Heb. good things<Rf><CM>

I have forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804> mine house<WH01004>, I have left<WH05203><WTH8804> mine heritage<WH05159>; I have given<WH05414><WTH8804> the dearly beloved<WH03033> of my soul<WH05315> into the hand<WH03709> of her enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>. <RF>the dearly...: Heb. the love<Rf>

Mine heritage<WH05159> is unto me as a lion<WH0738> in the forest<WH03293>; it crieth out<WH05414><WTH8804><WH06963> against me: therefore have I hated<WH08130><WTH8804> it. <RF>crieth...: or, yelleth: Heb. giveth out his voice<Rf>

Mine heritage<WH05159> <FI>is<Fi> unto me <FI>as<Fi> a speckled<WH06641> bird<WH05861>, the birds<WH05861> round about<WH05439> <FI>are<Fi> against her; come<WH03212><WTH8798> ye, assemble<WH0622><WTH8798> all the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704>, come<WH0857><WTH8685> to devour<WH0402>. <RF>speckled: or, taloned<Rf> <RF>come to: or, cause them to come to<Rf>

Many<WH07227> pastors<WH07462><WTH8802> have destroyed<WH07843><WTH8765> my vineyard<WH03754>, they have trodden<WH0947><WH00> my portion<WH02513> under foot<WH0947><WTH8790>, they have made<WH05414><WTH8804> my pleasant<WH02532> portion<WH02513> a desolate<WH08077> wilderness<WH04057>. <RF>pleasant...: Heb. portion of desire<Rf>

They have made<WH07760><WTH8804> it desolate<WH08076>, <FI>and being<Fi> desolate<WH08077> it mourneth<WH056><WTH8804> unto me; the whole land<WH0776> is made desolate<WH08074><WTH8738>, because no man<WH0376> layeth<WH07760><WTH8802> <FI>it<Fi> to heart<WH03820>.

The spoilers<WH07703><WTH8802> are come<WH0935><WTH8804> upon all high places<WH08205> through the wilderness<WH04057>: for the sword<WH02719> of the LORD<WH03068> shall devour<WH0398><WTH8802> from the <FI>one<Fi> end<WH07097> of the land<WH0776> even to the <FI>other<Fi> end<WH07097> of the land<WH0776>: no flesh<WH01320> shall have peace<WH07965>.

They have sown<WH02232><WTH8804> wheat<WH02406>, but shall reap<WH07114><WTH8804> thorns<WH06975>: they have put themselves to pain<WH02470><WTH8738>, <FI>but<Fi> shall not profit<WH03276><WTH8686>: and they shall be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8804> of your revenues<WH08393> because of the fierce<WH02740> anger<WH0639> of the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>they shall: or, ye shall<Rf><CM>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> against all mine evil<WH07451> neighbours<WH07934>, that touch<WH05060><WTH8802> the inheritance<WH05159> which I have caused my people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478> to inherit<WH05157><WTH8689>; Behold, I will pluck them out<WH05428><WTH8802> of their land<WH0127>, and pluck out<WH05428><WTH8799> the house<WH01004> of Judah<WH03063> from among<WH08432> them.

And it shall come to pass, after<WH0310> that I have plucked them out<WH05428><WTH8800> I will return<WH07725><WTH8799>, and have compassion<WH07355><WTH8765> on them, and will bring them again<WH07725><WTH8689>, every man<WH0376> to his heritage<WH05159>, and every man<WH0376> to his land<WH0776>.

And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently<WH03925><WTH8800> learn<WH03925><WTH8799> the ways<WH01870> of my people<WH05971>, to swear<WH07650><WTH8736> by my name<WH08034>, The LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>; as they taught<WH03925><WTH8765> my people<WH05971> to swear<WH07650><WTH8736> by Baal<WH01168>; then shall they be built<WH01129><WTH8738> in the midst<WH08432> of my people<WH05971>.

But if they will not obey<WH08085><WTH8799>, I will utterly<WH05428><WTH8800> pluck up<WH05428><WTH8804> and destroy<WH06><WTH8763> that nation<WH01471>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
